svg.title: The shell functional also has an ordinary face-flux interpretation. Let a closed coordinate box contain x0 strictly in its interior and every exterior insertion strictly outside the closed box. Integrate each a-component of the current on its upper face minus its lower face, with three- dimensional Lebesgue measure in the remaining coordinates. This sum equals (SC9). To prove it choose a smooth window supported strictly inside the box and equal to one near x0. Multiply the current by 1−χ. It is zero near the only enclosed insertion and smooth at all points of the box. Its divergence equals −P a ∂aχ Fa, by conservation and the Killing identity. The ordinary coordinate divergence theorem applies to this smooth truncated current. On every face χ = 0, so its face flux is the original one. The volume integral is (SC9), and cutoffindependence gives the equality for any allowed window. This argument treats faces with their outward orientations and does not integrate with four-dimensional ambient measure on the surface.
